instruction: Remember the first object on the conveyor, then pick the matching object when it appears again.

arguments.note: The first object is a dark blue keypad mobile phone with a pale screen and white buttons. I will remember that and start orienting the right gripper above the belt while observing its motion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The reference phone is moving toward image right, about 25 pixels during the last motion. I am finishing a downward grasp orientation while keeping clear of its path.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will wait over the middle conveyor lane for subsequent objects. The memorized target is the blue-and-white keypad phone, not just any rectangular object.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The combined reach was refused, so I will move forward in a smaller increment while staying above the belt.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The reference continues off to the right. I am setting a lower hover over its lane, still well above the belt, to prepare for the later match.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The right hand is ready above the belt. I am tilting the idle wrist camera down to watch incoming objects while the first phone leaves.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The downward idle camera only shows empty belt nearby; its original forward view was better for identifying arrivals. I restore that view while waiting for the next object.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The reference phone has left the visible belt. I keep the jaws open and wait above the lane for a matching later object.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s).

arguments.note: No later object is visible yet. I sweep the idle wrist view while keeping the picking arm stationary above the belt.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 37 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: An incoming white speckled cup is visible in the idle wrist camera; it does not match the blue keypad phone. I continue watching without grasping it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Behind the cup and other distractors, the idle camera shows another dark blue keypad phone. I shift the hovering picking hand leftward to intercept that match sooner.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The larger lateral shift was unreachable. I try a smaller shift while preserving the downward hover.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The matching phone is still upstream behind the distractors. I return the idle camera toward the central lane while allowing the objects to advance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 38 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The cup is passing into the head view and is not the target. I return the idle arm to its starting pose while leaving the right hand ready for the phone.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I continue observing the moving sequence, letting the cup and blue container pass. The phone remains the only object to pick.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The cup is advancing rightward; I leave it untouched and keep waiting for the remembered phone.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The visible cup and energy-drink can are distractors. I keep the open picking hand clear while the sequence advances.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I continue waiting above the moving belt, without touching the cup or can. The reference identity remains the dark blue keypad phone.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The matching blue phone is entering at the far left, in a lane closer to me than the reference used. I shift the hovering right hand toward that lane before it arrives.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The incoming phone has the same dark blue body, screen, and white keypad as the reference, but is rotated. I align the jaws across its narrow dimension before interception.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The match is still well upstream. With the hand now in the nearer lane, I move the hover point left to shorten its remaining travel to the grasp site.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is moving right at roughly 1.8 image pixels per control step. I keep the right hand hovering and let the intervening objects pass before descending.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The tall cup appears to have stalled against the hovering jaws. I raise the right hand to clear it and let the distractors continue past before approaching the low phone.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: A vertical lift was unreachable, so I retreat slightly toward the robot while lifting to clear the cup's path.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The matching phone is now near the left arm and clearly identifiable. I prepare the left hand for a downward interception instead of waiting for it to reach the right arm.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I position the left hand above a point ahead of the moving phone, with substantial vertical clearance so it is not stopped by the jaws.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The matching phone is approaching the left hover point behind the green distractor. I rotate the jaws to grasp across the phone rather than along its length.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is nearing the interception point. I lower to a closer hover, still above the object, so the final timed descent will be short.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is just upstream of the left jaws. I withdraw the unused right arm toward home while the phone advances into the left interception area.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 17 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The matching phone is now between the open jaws in the wrist view. I make a short descent and small lane correction, accounting for its continued rightward motion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone remains slightly left of the jaw center. I make a millimetre-scale lateral correction and lower closer to its sides before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is centered within the jaw opening and still advancing into it. I lower the final few millimetres and close on its sides now.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have stopped at the phone's width, and the phone is visibly held between them. I begin with a small lift to verify that it clears the belt securely.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone follows the jaws and is no longer travelling with the belt. I lift it more than ten centimetres to complete the matching pick.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is held but has pivoted downward in the jaws. I carry it higher and back toward the left home position so the whole object is clearly lifted above the belt.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
